stem.text: The diagram shows a child X of mass $20\,\text{kg}$ and a child Y of mass $15\,\text{kg}$ seated on a uniform plank.

stem.alt: Diagram of a plank balanced on a pivot below its middle, with child X (mass 20 kg) seated at the left end and child Y (mass 15 kg) seated at the right end; the plank is labelled mass 7.0 kg.

stem.text: The plank has a mass of $7.0\,\text{kg}$ and has a pivot at its midpoint. The plank is horizontal and in equilibrium.
Which statement about the weight of the plank is correct?

A.text: The weight of the plank can be considered to be acting at its midpoint.

B.text: The weight of the plank is causing an anticlockwise moment.

C.text: The weight of the plank is causing a clockwise moment.

D.text: The weight of the plank equals the force on the plank from the pivot.
